intro: IIT Hyderabad and IIIT Hyderabad both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded M.Tech / M.E. fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.
IIT Hyderabad vs IIIT Hyderabad is not a single winner. Both are recorded as public institutes. IIT Hyderabad holds NIRF 2025 rank 7 and IIIT Hyderabad holds rank 38 in the same listing we have.

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad vs IIIT Hyderabad for M.Tech / M.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIT Hyderabad if its M.Tech / M.E. programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want, including the stronger NIRF 2025 rank on this page.
Choose IIIT Hyderabad if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.

IIT Hyderabad lists M.Tech / M.E. - Aerospace Engineering, M.Tech / M.E. - Artificial Intelligence, M.Tech / M.E. - Environmental Engineering and more. IIIT Hyderabad lists M.Tech Bioinformatics, M.Tech Computational Linguistics (CL), M.Tech Computer Aided Structural Engineering (CASE) and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

IIT Hyderabad's official July–December 2026 PG fee notice lists regular M.Tech tuition of ₹12,000 a semester for General/EWS/OBC students (nil for SC/ST/PH). The first-semester grand total for a newly enrolled regular General student is ₹86,583, including one-time fees, hostel and mess. Self-sponsored M.Tech tuition is much higher, at ₹2.40 lakh a semester.

IIIT Hyderabad's official PG admissions page states that M.Tech tuition for academic year 2026–27 is ₹5 lakh, with hostel and mess extra at about ₹50,000 a semester. A semester's tuition is ₹2.50 lakh, plus a ₹10,000 admission fee at seat acceptance.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for IIT Hyderabad on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.

We hold a placement row for IIIT Hyderabad, but we could not verify it on an official placement report we opened. Do not treat the recorded package as confirmed until the institute's latest official report is checked.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IIT Hyderabad admits regular M.Tech students mainly through GATE, and then its own offer process. Category-wise fee waivers and sponsored seats follow the official PG fee notice.

IIIT Hyderabad admits M.Tech students through its PGEE, and also lists GATE as a recorded route on this page. Seat acceptance requires the official admission fee and a semester's tuition, as stated on the PG admissions site.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a regular, GATE-centred M.Tech with IIT fee rules and the higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank on this page, IIT Hyderabad is the stronger general fit.
If you want IIIT Hyderabad's more specialised M.Tech programmes and can budget the official ₹5 lakh annual tuition for 2026–27, plus hostel and mess, IIIT Hyderabad is the more direct choice.
